product_fix: Owned staging cleanup for XMP, SQLite backup and derived DNG. A separate flock-protected ownership record contains the exact stage pathname/device/inode. Recovery preserves active workers, legacy/unmarked files, symlinks and replaced inodes. XMP cleans on next write; backup/derived managed folders also clean during normal Library recovery. Original content and installed hard-linked results are preserved.
contracts: Catalog: distinct prepare/verify process pairs before/after actual saveEdits COMMIT. Full old/new document, exact revisions, original SHA, fresh Undo.
Backup: SIGKILL after actual sqlite3_backup_step before publication; prior valid snapshot hashes survive, no partial destination, real UI retry publishes one verified complete snapshot.

Relink: SIGKILL during actual WAL write; old mapping remains Missing, retry updates it once with preserved original, complete document and metadata (including intentional metadata revision increment). Native chooser selection uses an explicit owned-path boundary, not picker navigation.
Batch: three selected metadata rows and fourth control, real WAL-write kill. All old rows persist, retry commits all three exactly once; complete original/Develop invariants hold.

HDR: real Bayer decode/alignment/merge/Float DNG install precedes kill before registration. Normal startup consumes journal exactly once, preserves source documents, dynamic range and checksums; recovered result renders independently and supports exact Undo.

retained_failures: Initial compilation caught std::vector.contains in a test-only selection oracle; replaced by std::find.

First execution: 2 PASS / 3 FAIL. Two fixtures called openFirst (imports 10) with one supplied photo; now import one explicitly. Relink retry oracle omitted the existing intentional metadata revision +1; corrected after verifying complete stored rows and production transaction.
Initial supervisor unit fixture omitted mandatory metrics.json; corrected without changing parent SIGKILL validation. New tests require both commit checkpoint pairs and propagate any stage failure.

Initial inode-flock staging design conflicted with SQLite, causing two 15-second backup failures and a Library startup timeout. Separate ownership-record locks remove this interference; all nine affected CTest entries pass.
Initial tidy identified an unused merge result and two test RAII declarations; explicit discard and maybe_unused guards fixed all mandatory diagnostics.

validation.strengthened_staging_safety_ctest: PASS (live same/other process locks, real SIGKILL, replaced inode, symlink, mismatched pathname, prior output, companions, idempotence)

symbol_isolation.scope: Global renderer signatures and all defined observer symbols; no signing, distribution or runtime qualification

limits: Cleanup intentionally preserves legacy stages and incomplete/invalid ownership records; a kill during ownership initialization can leave such unclassified scratch files. It does not certify power-loss or external-volume behavior.
The filesystem selection fixtures do not qualify native picker navigation.
Only the existing 8 GiB M3 and built-in Retina were used.
Two applicable blocking IDs from phases 0.6–0.9 remain without adapters; phase 1.0, complete quality/load/performance, artifact/update gates and BUG045/069 remain open.
